phrase: the bullet time thingy where the camera swishes around them mid-air
interpretation: 'Bullet time' is a frozen-moment arc: time almost stops while the camera moves.
'Swishy' is a fast move with motion blur: a whip pan, a fast arc or a crash zoom.
'Around them' is an arc shot. A partial arc is safer than a full circle.
Air moments read best from a low camera, with a real height and real gravity.
subject: two masked ninjas
action: at the top of a jump off a low wall

options.label: A
options.plain: Time almost stops and the camera sweeps part of the way around the subject.
options.movement: a fast, smooth arc of about 130 degrees around the subject: it starts behind the shoulder, passes the profile and stops at a front three-quarter view; it never reaches a view straight in front
options.placement: at the subject's own height, the lens level, 2 to 3 m away, on one side of the action for the whole move
options.lens_why: Wide enough to feel the camera travel past the background, not so wide that bodies bend at the frame edge.

light.name: One hard low sun, camera facing into the light
light.plain: A single low, hard sun behind the subject. The camera looks toward it.
light.prompt: one hard low sun as the only strong light, behind the subject; the camera faces into the light; bright rims on hair and shoulders, long shadows that fall toward the lens, about a third of the frame in deep true shadow

grade.name: Film print, deep blacks
grade.plain: Looks like real film: fine grain, true black shadows, natural colour.
grade.prompt: photochemical film look: fine grain, deep true blacks with detail, natural skin and material colours, restrained saturation

speed.name: Frozen moment
speed.plain: Time almost stops while the camera keeps moving.
speed.prompt: time almost stops: the subject drifts only a hand's width while the camera moves fast; real gravity returns at the end of the move
speed.still: everything caught perfectly sharp at one instant: dust and small debris hang still in the air

options.feel: The viewer gets a held breath: one instant, seen from more than one side.
options.when: One peak moment in the whole piece: the top of a jump, the instant before a landing or a hit.
risks: A full 180 or 360 degree orbit turns faces into the lens and flips left and right on screen. Ask for about 130 degrees.
Generators let frozen bodies float upward. Write 'real gravity, drifting only a hand's width'.
The background behind the subject is invented during the move. Keep the place simple.
options.still: the camera is at the middle of its arc, exactly side-on: the subject in clean profile at their own height
options.snippet: {subject} {action}; time almost stops while the camera sweeps a fast, smooth arc of about 130 degrees around them at their own height, lens level, from behind the shoulder past the profile to a front three-quarter view
options.recommended_because: It is the closest match to your words. Best for: one peak moment in the whole piece: the top of a jump, the instant before a landing or a hit.

options.label: B
options.plain: The camera swings around the subject at normal speed, fast, and stops.
options.movement: one fast arc of about 90 degrees around the subject in real time, starting on a whip of motion blur and stopping dead on a side-on frame
options.placement: at waist height, 2 m away, the lens level, on one side of the action
options.lens_why: A wide lens close to the subject makes the swing feel fast and keeps the place in the frame.

light.name: Low hard side sun
light.plain: Late sun from one side. One half of everything is lit, one half is dark.
light.prompt: low, hard late-afternoon sun from one side only; one side of the subject lit, the other side in real shadow; long hard-edged shadows across the ground

grade.name: Warm natural
grade.plain: Warm sunlight colour, but real: no orange wash over everything.
grade.prompt: warm natural grade: warm highlights where the sun lands, neutral shadows, natural colours, true blacks

speed.name: Real time
speed.plain: Normal speed. Fast things are fast.
speed.prompt: real time for the whole shot, fast and crisp, no slow motion
speed.still: a sharp frame with a little natural motion blur on the fastest limb only

options.feel: Energy and swagger. The camera has an attitude of its own.
options.when: An entrance, a trick, a turn: any moment that needs speed more than awe.
risks: Generators slow an arc to a gentle drift. Write 'fast', 'real time' and where it stops.
A wide lens stretches faces near the frame edge. Keep faces near the middle third.
options.still: the camera is low at waist height and close, three-quarter from behind the subject, the background streaked sideways by the fast swing while the subject stays sharp
options.snippet: {subject} {action}; in real time the camera whips one fast arc of about 90 degrees around them at waist height, close on a wide lens, and stops dead side-on
slop_avoided: Aquarium speed: slow floating camera and slow bodies
